GetData Missing Authorization Information Disclosure Vulnerability 2022-01-06 CVE-2021-35001 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2021-35001 3.1 AV:N/AC:H/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N ['BMC'] ['Track-It!'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of BMC Track-It!. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the GetData endpoint. The issue results from the lack of authorization prior to allowing access to functionality. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose stored credentials, leading to further compromise.
